newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady on Thursday, USDA said. Buyer inquiry decent.
Seller interest somewhat limited as the bulk of this week's
showlists already traded.
Confirmed - 4,700 Last Week - 2,700 Last Year - 12,200

Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
NEBRASKA FEEDLOT WEEKLY SUMMARY, week ending July 17, 1997 Confirmed - 100,000 Last Week - 77,900 Last Year - 73,200

Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis mostly 2.00 higher; dressed basis mostly 3.00 higher. Demand somewhat uneven from day to day, but all buying interests eventually participated at the going prices. Producers became active traders at the market advance, and for the most part, showlists will "clean up" fairly well. The weekly total includes 12,200 previously contracted or formulated cattle.
